title: Refresh alwaysPrepared at level-up and character creation
description: eshyra-odpc.1 recomputes sheet.spellcasting.alwaysPrepared (domain/oath/circle spells) only during long-rest preparation. Level-up (new subclass or levels crossing a table row) and creation do not yet refresh it, so a freshly-leveled cleric/paladin/druid shows stale or absent alwaysPrepared until the next preparation. Reuse alwaysPreparedFor in packages/core/src/character/spellPreparation.ts (export it). levelUpEngine.ts is where level-up would call it.
notes: Sol review eshyra-kn38.2 (700f4acd): S1+S2 material. Fixed at 25f189a7 by supervisor (normalize prepared vs alwaysPrepared every level-up; resulting == persisted); invariant tests negative-proofed. Re-review requested.
